automation_modality.hard_work_law: Automation never replaces vocabulary, bounded contexts, authority, invariants, evidence acquisition, qualification, numerical or policy evaluation, human judgment where required, effects, receipts or relying-party acceptance.
automation_modality.law: Predictive models may implement an explicitly selected scoring or risk method and models or agents may propose drafts, evidence candidates, triage or explanations; typed contracts, deterministic policy, qualified methods, named authorities and effect gates decide every authoritative transition.
automation_modality.removal_law: Removing every optional model or agent extension preserves deterministic collaboration policy and release, rights/retention case control, rules-based entity resolution, assurance appraisal, evidence, refusal and effect contracts; explicitly selected predictive methods may instead become capability_unavailable.

definition: How can a relying party obtain a scoped, evidence-linked and challengeable appraisal of a precise claim without confusing tests, attestations or approvals with truth?
invariants: claim identity includes scope and criteria edition
independence is occurrence evidence not a product label
verdict preserves limitations, defeaters and residual gaps
jobs: issue disclose supersede withdraw and reappraise bounded verdicts
name: Assurance Case and Appraisal
negative_mission: Does not invent legal, source, master-data, analytical, runtime, accreditation or relying-party authority.
